notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276277/6d7727d80dabf2a3ee390e366339dc9c8916698b.png[/img]

[b][u]Hello Everyone![/u][/b]

The time has come, I have finally updated this game. This update comes with a few minor changes to the base game along with a major new Halloween mode for you to try to conquer.

[i][u][b]Base Game[/b][/u][/i]

[list]
[*]Added new jumpscare animation for the entity
[/list]

[i][u][b]Halloween Mode[/b][/u][/i]

[list]
[*]New Mode with no pixelization, theme is realistic
[*]New model for the entity strictly in Halloween mode
[*]Whole new level with new mechanics
[*]Normal and Hard mode achievements
[/list]

Let me know how you like the update, and let me know if you want any additions, changes, or updates. I'm happy to add them as necessary. 

Seeya,
Josh

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276277/e331e239c0b045875130e952f5df89229504f6b3.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Update/Future Content Plans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43276277/e331e239c0b045875130e952f5df89229504f6b3.png[/img]

Hey all, 

TL;DR: New trailer for Halloween mode is posted on the steam page. This will include a new Halloween themed mode with a new monster, house, and mechanics. I also might add more updates to the mode after launch if people like it!

Thank you so much for those of you who played From The Rain within the last year. This game was truly a large learning experience for me and it was really fun launching an official project on Steam.

However, this game did not come without it's flaws. I understand that, and I have been continuing to grow as a game developer within the last year. I always wanted to release more content to this game, but never found any good worthwhile ideas until I had the idea to add a Halloween mode. I have been kind of rushing to get this update out within the last month, and I don't have enough time to add all the features I initially planned on adding. However, if the update and mode is well received I have no problem continuing to work on the mode and updating it.

After this project, I plan on working on one more solo project. I have been kind of dry on ideas lately, which explains the lack of new content. By the new year I should also have a partner that I will start working on new games with as well, which may be any genre. Any ideas for any type of game are very appreciated! 

But yeah, I just wanted to re-say a thank you and let you know there is some more content coming shortly. If you want to contact me you can always join the discord linked on the steam page or DM me on Twitter. PEACE.

notes.title: From The Rain releases today!
notes.content:
My very first Steam game releases today! 

From The Rain releases with a full story and new mechanics. Survive the terrors that haunt you from the rain and explore the endings! 

News: There is much that I decided to leave out of the initial build as I felt that I needed more time to polish (and create) more features. So, here are my promises for future updates.

[list]
[*] Bug fixes (if any)
[*] More endings! (Currently 2, planning on doubling that.)
[*] More extra modes! (You'll get what I mean once you beat the game ;) )
[*] More environmental props
[/list]

Also, if you wish to talk to me or report any bugs, join the official From The Rain discord!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/eGYnjpMavK]From The Rain Official Discord[/url]

At any rate, I hope you all enjoy the first release of the game. I encourage all feedback as it helps me improve greatly as a developer!
